string.text: {=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_1_text}Noble Houses of Gondor

{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_1_desc}Your family belonged to one of Gondor's noble houses, sworn to defend the White Tree. Your father was a knight who fought bravely in service to the Steward, while your mother managed the family's lands and affairs.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_2_text}Merchants of the White City

{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_2_desc}Your family were prosperous traders within Minas Tirith, dealing in fine goods and wares. Their influence within the city's merchant guilds brought wealth and respect to your household.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_3_text}Farmers of the Pelennor

{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_3_desc}Your family tilled the rich soil of the Pelennor Fields, providing sustenance for Minas Tirith. They also served as levy soldiers, standing in defense of the city during times of war.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_4_text}Artisans of Minas Tirith

{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_4_desc}Your family were skilled craftsmen in Minas Tirith, creating fine armor, weapons, and tapestries that adorned the halls of the White City. Their artistry was renowned across Gondor.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_5_text}Rangers of Ithilien

{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_5_desc}Your family were members of the Rangers of Ithilien, skilled in the arts of stealth and archery. They patrolled the wilds, protecting Gondor's borders from the forces of Mordor.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_6_text}Street Urchins of Osgiliath

{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_6_desc}Your family lived among the ruins of Osgiliath, surviving through cunning and resourcefulness. They scavenged what they could and occasionally served under Gondor's banners as irregular troops.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_1_text}Servants of the Dark Tower

{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_1_desc}Your family served directly under the command of the Dark Tower. Your father was a brutal enforcer, while your mother worked to instill the will of Sauron among the lesser folk.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_2_text}Merchants of the Black Road
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_2_desc}Your family managed trade and supplies within Mordor, ensuring the armies of Sauron were equipped for war. Their dealings were shadowed by intrigue and violence.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_3_text}Slaves of Barad-dur

{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_3_desc}Your family were enslaved laborers, toiling in the forges and quarries of Mordor to fuel the war machine of the Dark Lord. Their resilience became a testament to their will to survive.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_4_text}Orc Taskmasters
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_4_desc}Your family were tasked with overseeing the labor of Orcs and Men alike, ensuring that Sauron's orders were carried out with ruthless efficiency.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_5_text}Hunters of Gorgoroth
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_5_desc}Your family roamed the volcanic plains of Gorgoroth, hunting and tracking prey to sustain the armies of Mordor. Their skill in the wilderness was unmatched.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_6_text}Uruk Overseers
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_6_desc}Your family served as overseers for the Uruk-hai legions, enforcing discipline and maintaining order within Sauron's ranks.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_erebor_1_text}Noble of the Lonely Mountain
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_erebor_1_desc}Your family was of Erebor's noble line, kin to King Dain, wielding mighty axes and inspiring warriors to defend the Lonely Mountain's honor.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_erebor_2_text}Master Smith
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_erebor_2_desc}Your family forged legendary arms in Erebor's blazing halls, crafting blades and armor coveted across Middle-earth, and traded them for wealth.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_erebor_3_text}Delve Miner
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_erebor_3_desc}Your family toiled in Erebor's deepest mines, unearthing mithril and gems, and learned to fortify the mountain against invaders.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_erebor_4_text}Ironfoot Warrior
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_erebor_4_desc}Your family fought with Dain Ironfoot's warriors, mastering axe and shield and wielding crossbows to hold Erebor's gates.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_erebor_5_text}Vault Keeper
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_erebor_5_desc}Your family guarded Erebor's vast treasuries, managing its riches and planning defenses to protect the mountain's wealth from foes.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_erebor_6_text}Mountain Scout
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_erebor_6_desc}Your family patrolled the wilds around Erebor, tracking Orcs and firing bows to safeguard the Lonely Mountain's borders.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_rivendell_1_text}Nobles of Imladris
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_rivendell_1_desc}Your family were esteemed Elves of Imladris, sworn to serve Elrond. They carried the wisdom of ages and the strength to defend Rivendell in its time of need.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_rivendell_2_text}Artisans of Rivendell
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_rivendell_2_desc}Your family were skilled craftsmen and loremasters, creating wonders of Elven craftsmanship and preserving the ancient knowledge of Middle-earth.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_rivendell_3_text}Farmers of the Hidden Valley
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_rivendell_3_desc}Your family tended the fertile fields of Rivendell, ensuring its people and guests were well-fed and sustained in their peaceful haven.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_rivendell_4_text}Wardens of the Valley
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_rivendell_4_desc}Your family served as scouts and guardians, patrolling the borders of Imladris and ensuring the valley remained a sanctuary free from evil.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_rivendell_5_text}Elven Scholars
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_rivendell_5_desc}Your family were scholars of lore, healing, and magic, preserving the ancient knowledge of the Elves and aiding the free peoples of Middle-earth.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_rivendell_6_text}Wanderers of the Wild
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_rivendell_6_desc}Your family were known to venture beyond Rivendell, aiding those in need and learning of the changing world beyond the valley.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mirkwood_1_text}Descendants of Woodland Nobility
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mirkwood_1_desc}Your family descended from the noble houses of the Woodland Realm, serving as close advisors and protectors of King Thranduil's court.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mirkwood_2_text}Merchants of the Forest Path
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mirkwood_2_desc}Your family were merchants who traveled the treacherous paths of Mirkwood, bringing goods and trade to the Elvenking's halls.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mirkwood_3_text}Woodland Farmers
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mirkwood_3_desc}Your family lived on the fringes of the Woodland Realm, cultivating the land and gathering what little the shadowed forest provided.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mirkwood_4_text}Artisans of the Woodland Halls
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mirkwood_4_desc}Your family were artisans of the Woodland Realm, crafting exquisite weapons and tools from the resources of the forest.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mirkwood_5_text}Hunters of the Deep Woods
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mirkwood_5_desc}Your family were skilled hunters who braved the shadowy depths of Mirkwood to provide food and fend off the creatures that lurk within.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mirkwood_6_text}Rangers of the Woodland Realm
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mirkwood_6_desc}Your family served as rangers, protecting the borders of the Woodland Realm and guarding the forest paths from intruders and threats alike.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_lothlorien_1_text}Nobles of Caras Galadhon
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_lothlorien_1_desc}Your family served directly under the guidance of Lady Galadriel and Lord Celeborn, defending the heart of Lothlorien with unwavering dedication.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_lothlorien_2_text}Artisans of the Golden Wood
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_lothlorien_2_desc}Your family were master artisans, weaving the beauty of the Golden Wood into their creations, from armor to musical instruments.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_lothlorien_3_text}Guardians of the Mallorn Trees
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_lothlorien_3_desc}Your family protected the sacred Mallorn trees, ensuring the splendor of Lothlorien endured against any threat.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_lothlorien_4_text}Rangers of the Dimrill Dale
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_lothlorien_4_desc}Your family patrolled the borders of Lothlorien, guarding the passes and defending against Orcs and other intruders.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_lothlorien_5_text}Healers of the Golden Wood
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_lothlorien_5_desc}Your family tended to the wounded and preserved the ancient wisdom of healing within the Golden Wood.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_lothlorien_6_text}Wanderers of the Galadhrim
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_lothlorien_6_desc}Your family roamed the lands beyond Lothlorien, aiding allies and spreading word of the Golden Wood's splendor.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_1_text}Servants of Saruman
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_1_desc}Your family worked under the orders of Saruman the White, managing his domain and assisting in his schemes of conquest.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_2_text}Craftsmen of Orthanc
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_2_desc}Your family crafted tools and weapons within the shadow of Orthanc, forging instruments of Saruman's will.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_3_text}Laborers of the Deeping Caves
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_3_desc}Your family toiled in the deep pits of Isengard, extracting stone and ore to fuel Saruman's ambitions.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_4_text}Uruk-Hai Warriors
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_4_desc}Your family were among the first Uruk-Hai bred by Saruman, warriors forged for war and domination.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_5_text}Scouts of the Wold
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_5_desc}Your family were scouts and trackers, ensuring Saruman's forces moved unseen across the plains of Rohan.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_6_text}Rogues of Isengard
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_6_desc}Your family operated in the shadows, gathering intelligence and undermining the enemies of Saruman.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gundabad_1_text}Nobles of Gundabad
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gundabad_1_desc}Your family were among the noble elite of Gundabad, dedicated to reclaiming their ancestral home and defending it from invaders.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gundabad_2_text}Smiths of Gundabad
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gundabad_2_desc}Your family were skilled smiths, crafting tools and weapons to equip the defenders of Gundabad.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gundabad_3_text}Miners of Gundabad
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gundabad_3_desc}Your family worked tirelessly in the mines of Gundabad, uncovering its hidden riches.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gundabad_4_text}Warriors of the Grey Mountains
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gundabad_4_desc}Your family fought against Orcs and other threats in the Grey Mountains, upholding the honor of their kin.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gundabad_5_text}Rangers of Gundabad
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gundabad_5_desc}Your family served as rangers, patrolling the wilds around Gundabad and safeguarding its borders from harm.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gundabad_6_text}Outcasts of the Mountains
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gundabad_6_desc}Your family lived on the fringes of Gundabad's society, surviving through cunning and ruthlessness in the unforgiving mountain passes.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_1_text}Servants of the Necromancer
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_1_desc}Your family served directly under the Necromancer, performing his dark bidding and enforcing his will across the region.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_2_text}Crafters of Shadowed Steel
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_2_desc}Your family forged weapons and armor imbued with the dark magic of Dol Guldur, equipping its armies for conquest.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_3_text}Miners of the Shadowed Halls
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_3_desc}Your family labored deep within the caverns of Dol Guldur, extracting resources to feed its war machine.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_4_text}Warriors of the Enchanted Wood
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_4_desc}Your family were fierce warriors who fought to extend the shadow of Dol Guldur over the surrounding lands.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_5_text}Hunters of the Dark Forest
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_5_desc}Your family hunted the twisted creatures of the forest and tracked those who dared trespass into the Necromancer's domain.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_6_text}Rogues of Dol Guldur
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_6_desc}Your family were spies and saboteurs, spreading the influence of Dol Guldur through deception and fear.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_1_text}Corsair Captains
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_1_desc}Your family were leaders among the Corsairs of Umbar, commanding ships and raiding the coasts of Gondor.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_2_text}Merchants of the Black Tide
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_2_desc}Your family conducted trade across the seas, often smuggling goods to fund the Corsairs' endeavors.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_3_text}Shipwrights of Umbar
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_3_desc}Your family constructed the vessels that carried the Corsairs to war, crafting ships of speed and stealth.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_4_text}Pirates of the Coasts
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_4_desc}Your family were Corsairs who raided the shores of Gondor and beyond, striking fear into the hearts of their enemies.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_5_text}Navigators of the High Seas
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_5_desc}Your family were skilled navigators, charting the dangerous seas and leading the Corsairs to victory.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_6_text}Smugglers of Umbar
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_6_desc}Your family moved in the shadows, smuggling goods and information vital to the survival of the Corsairs.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_empire_1_text}Descendants of Old Chieftains

{=taom_cc_taom_parent_empire_1_desc}Your family held sway as chieftains among the Dunlending clans, commanding respect through lineage and strength. Your father rallied warriors in times of conflict, while your mother managed the clan's affairs.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_empire_2_text}Clan Merchants
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_empire_2_desc}Your family traded goods between the Dunlending clans and the outside world. Their knowledge of the land and its people brought prosperity to your household.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_empire_3_text}Free Clansfolk
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_empire_3_desc}Your family were free folk of Dunland, tilling the soil and herding sheep among the hills. They answered the call of the chieftains when war came.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_empire_4_text}Skilled Artisans
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_empire_4_desc}Your family were craftsmen of the Dunlending clans, fashioning weapons, tools, and ornaments from the resources of the hills.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_empire_5_text}Woodland Foragers
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_empire_5_desc}Your family lived off the wild lands of Dunland, hunting game and gathering herbs in the dense forests that bordered the Misty Mountains.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_empire_6_text}Wanderers and Outcasts
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_empire_6_desc}Your family were drifters, cast out from the clans or choosing to live beyond their reach. They survived by their wits and occasionally by less honest means.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_1_text}Retainers of the Marshal
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_1_desc}Your family served the marshals of the Riddermark, riding with them in defense of Rohan's borders. Your father was a skilled horseman and warrior.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_2_text}Merchants of Edoras
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_2_desc}Your family were traders in the great hall-city of Edoras, bringing goods from across the Riddermark and beyond to the people of Rohan.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_3_text}Freeholders of the Westfold
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_3_desc}Your family were free farmers of the Westfold, raising horses and crops on the fertile plains. They served as mounted levy when the king called.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_4_text}Smiths of Aldburg
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_4_desc}Your family were renowned smiths in Aldburg, forging the blades and armor that equipped the Rohirrim for battle.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_5_text}Hunters of the Eastfold
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_5_desc}Your family were hunters and trackers in the Eastfold, skilled with the bow and knowledgeable in the ways of the wild.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_6_text}Wanderers of the Wold
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_6_desc}Your family drifted across the Wold, the wild grasslands between Rohan and the Brown Lands. They survived by their wits and occasional service as scouts.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_sturgia_1_text}Servants of King of Dale
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_sturgia_1_desc}Your family served directly under the court of the King of Dale, managing the affairs of the kingdom and defending its people.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_sturgia_2_text}Urban Traders
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_sturgia_2_desc}Your family were merchants of Dale, trading in the fine wares and toys that made the city famous across the North.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_sturgia_3_text}Free Farmers
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_sturgia_3_desc}Your family were farmers in the lands around Dale and Esgaroth, working the fields and fishing the Long Lake.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_sturgia_4_text}Urban Artisans
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_sturgia_4_desc}Your family were craftsmen in Dale, famous for their toy-making and metalwork that drew traders from distant lands.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_sturgia_5_text}Forest Hunters
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_sturgia_5_desc}Your family were hunters and woodsmen in the forests around Dale, providing furs and game for the city's markets.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_sturgia_6_desc}Your family lived on the margins of society in Dale, surviving through odd jobs and sometimes less reputable means.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_aserai_1_text}Allies of Black Serpent
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_aserai_1_desc}Your family were loyal to the Black Serpent, leading warbands into the northern lands at the behest of the Dark Lord.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_aserai_2_text}Desert Warriors
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_aserai_2_desc}Your family were fierce warriors of the Haradrim, trained from youth to fight in the scorching deserts of the South.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_aserai_3_text}Traders of the South
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_aserai_3_desc}Your family conducted trade along the southern roads, bringing exotic goods and spices to the markets of Harad.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_aserai_4_text}Desert Farmers
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_aserai_4_desc}Your family worked the oases and irrigated lands of Harad, coaxing life from the arid soil with skill and patience.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_aserai_5_text}Nomadic Tribespeople
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_aserai_5_desc}Your family roamed the vast deserts, following ancient paths between water sources and trading with settled peoples.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_aserai_6_text}Desert Outlaws
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_aserai_6_desc}Your family survived on the fringes of Haradrim society, raiding caravans and living by their cunning in the endless sands.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_battania_1_text}Horse-Lords of Khand
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_battania_1_desc}Your family were lords of the Variag horse clans, commanding fierce mounted warriors across the steppes of Khand.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_battania_2_text}Nomadic Healers
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_battania_2_desc}Your family were healers and wise folk of the Variag clans, tending to the sick and preserving ancient remedies.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_battania_3_text}Clan Warriors
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_battania_3_desc}Your family were warriors of the Variag clans, skilled in mounted combat and fiercely loyal to their chieftain.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_battania_4_text}Smiths of the Steppes
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_battania_4_desc}Your family were smiths of the Variag people, crafting weapons and horse gear from the metals of the eastern mountains.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_battania_5_text}Steppe Hunters
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_battania_5_desc}Your family hunted across the vast steppes of Khand, tracking game and guarding the herds from predators.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_battania_6_text}Bards of Khand
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_battania_6_desc}Your family were traveling bards and storytellers, keeping alive the oral traditions of the Variag people through song and tale.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_khuzait_1_text}Kinsfolk of Chieftain
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_khuzait_1_desc}Your family were close kin to the Easterling chieftain, holding positions of power and commanding respect among the warrior clans.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_khuzait_2_text}Merchants of East
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_khuzait_2_desc}Your family traded along the eastern routes, bringing goods from distant lands to the markets of Rhun.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_khuzait_3_text}Nomadic Tribesfolk
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_khuzait_3_desc}Your family were nomads of the eastern plains, moving with the seasons and living off the land.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_khuzait_4_text}Steppe Farmers
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_khuzait_4_desc}Your family worked the fertile valleys near the inland sea of Rhun, growing grain and raising livestock.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_khuzait_5_text}Spirit Callers
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_khuzait_5_desc}Your family were shamans and spirit-speakers of the Easterling clans, communing with the spirits of the land and sky.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_khuzait_6_text}Outland Scouts
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_khuzait_6_desc}Your family served as scouts and outriders for the Easterling host, ranging far ahead of the main force to gather intelligence.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_goblin_1_text}Chiefs of Goblin-town
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_goblin_1_desc}Your family were among the noble elite of Goblin-town, dedicated to reclaiming their ancestral home and defending it from invaders.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_goblin_2_text}Tinkerers of Goblin-town
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_goblin_2_desc}Your family were skilled smiths, crafting tools and weapons to equip the defenders of Goblin-town.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_goblin_3_text}Miners of Goblin-town
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_goblin_3_desc}Your family worked tirelessly in the mines of Goblin-town, uncovering its hidden riches.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_goblin_4_text}Warriors of the Grey Mountains
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_goblin_4_desc}Your family fought against Orcs and other threats in the Grey Mountains, upholding the honor of their kin.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_goblin_5_text}Rangers of Goblin-town
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_goblin_5_desc}Your family served as rangers, patrolling the wilds around Goblin-town and safeguarding its borders from harm.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_goblin_6_text}Outcasts of the Mountains
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_goblin_6_desc}Your family lived on the fringes of Goblin-town's society, surviving through cunning and ruthlessness in the unforgiving mountain passes.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mistymountainorcs_1_text}Warlords of the Misty Mountains
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mistymountainorcs_1_desc}Your family were among the noble elite of the Misty Mountains, dedicated to reclaiming their ancestral home and defending it from invaders.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mistymountainorcs_2_text}Smiths of Moria
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mistymountainorcs_2_desc}Your family were skilled smiths, crafting tools and weapons to equip the defenders of the Misty Mountains.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mistymountainorcs_3_text}Miners of the Misty Mountains
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mistymountainorcs_3_desc}Your family worked tirelessly in the mines of the Misty Mountains, uncovering its hidden riches.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mistymountainorcs_4_text}Warriors of the Grey Mountains
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mistymountainorcs_4_desc}Your family fought against Orcs and other threats in the Grey Mountains, upholding the honor of their kin.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mistymountainorcs_5_text}Rangers of the Misty Mountains
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mistymountainorcs_5_desc}Your family served as rangers, patrolling the wilds around the Misty Mountains and safeguarding its borders from harm.
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mistymountainorcs_6_text}Outcasts of the Mountains
{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mistymountainorcs_6_desc}Your family lived on the fringes of the Misty Mountains's society, surviving through cunning and ruthlessness in the unforgiving mountain passes.
{=taom_cc_taom_childhood_leadership_text}your leadership skills.

{=taom_cc_taom_childhood_leadership_desc}In the shadow of ancient ruins, your youthful band of companions looked to you for guidance. Whether charting a safe path through the woods or rallying courage against imagined foes, your natural leadership shone like the banners of the kings of old.
{=taom_cc_taom_childhood_fighting_text}your fighting skills.

{=taom_cc_taom_childhood_fighting_desc}Your strength was the stuff of stories among the village children. They marveled at your ability to carry burdens like a seasoned warrior and hurl stones with the force of a trebuchet. Even then, you were compared to the heroes of legend.
{=taom_cc_taom_childhood_history_text}your history skills.

{=taom_cc_taom_childhood_history_desc}With keen eyes that missed no movement and quick feet that outran most, you were often the first to spot a deer trail or the glint of a hidden trinket. Your friends likened you to the rangers of the north, silent and observant.
{=taom_cc_taom_childhood_convince_text}your ability to convince others.

{=taom_cc_taom_childhood_convince_desc}While others played, you lingered in the market, watching merchants haggle over prices and tally profits. You were fascinated by the craft of trade, often imagining yourself as a steward of Gondor or a dwarven craftsman counting gems.
{=taom_cc_taom_childhood_charge_text}your ability to take charge of the situation.

{=taom_cc_taom_childhood_charge_desc}You had a natural gift for understanding others, often diffusing arguments and winning friends with ease. Your elders said you had the charisma of an elven lord, while your peers followed you with unwavering loyalty.
{=taom_cc_taom_childhood_horses_text}your skill with horses.

{=taom_cc_taom_childhood_horses_desc}You felt a deep bond with animals, particularly horses. The stable hands marveled at how you could calm even the most spirited steed, and your skill in caring for wounds brought whispers that you might rival the horsemasters of Rohan one day.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_1_text}Trained with the Swan Knights.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_1_desc}You joined the ranks of the Swan Knights of Dol Amroth, learning the art of mounted combat and chivalric warfare under the banners of Gondor's finest.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_2_text}Stood guard in Minas Tirith.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_2_desc}You served in the garrison of Minas Tirith, defending the White City's walls and learning the art of siege defense from its veteran commanders.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_3_text}Rode with the Rangers of Ithilien.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_3_desc}You patrolled the wilds of Ithilien, striking at the enemy from the shadows and honing your skills as a ranger in the tradition of Faramir's company.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_4_text}Trained with the Tower Guard.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_4_desc}You joined the elite Tower Guard of Gondor, training in disciplined infantry warfare to protect the Citadel and the White Tree.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_5_text}Lived by your wits in the ruins of Osgiliath.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_5_desc}You scraped by in the contested ruins of Osgiliath, learning the lethal economy of street-fighting and the value of a well-thrown stone. Survival in that half-drowned maze of broken stone shaped you into someone who could improvise anything from nothing.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_1_text}Trained with the Warg Riders.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_1_desc}You were chosen to train with the elite Warg Riders of Mordor, learning to control the fearsome beasts and strike terror into the hearts of the enemy.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_2_text}Manned the towers of Mordor's fortresses.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_2_desc}You were stationed on the watchtowers and walls of Mordor's black fortresses, scanning the horizon for movement and directing fire on any who approached. The post suited those who could think as well as shoot.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_3_text}Rode with the Black Scouts.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_3_desc}You joined the Black Scouts, riding swiftly through the wastelands to gather intelligence and harry the enemy's flanks.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_4_text}Marched in the Orc legions of the Dark Lord.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_4_desc}You drilled in the relentless formations of Sauron's infantry, learning to shoulder-charge and cut with blade and axe in ranks that moved like a single armoured fist. Weakness was punished and strength rewarded in iron.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_5_text}Joined the Shadow Skirmishers.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_5_desc}You became a Shadow Skirmisher, harassing the enemy with thrown weapons and quick strikes before melting back into the darkness.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_6_text}Lived on the fringes of Sauron's war host.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_6_desc}You were neither soldier nor slave, moving on the shadowed margins of Mordor's great army — stealing what you could, trading information, and learning which officers were bribeable and which were better avoided. Cunning was the only currency you trusted.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_erebor_1_text}Served in the Royal Guard of Erebor.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_erebor_1_desc}You pledged your loyalty to the King Under the Mountain, serving in the elite Royal Guard and learning to wield axe and hammer in defense of the realm.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_erebor_2_text}Defended the gates of Erebor.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_erebor_2_desc}As part of Erebor's garrison, you manned the crossbows and held the gates against all comers, learning the art of dwarven siege defense.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_erebor_3_text}Trained with the Iron Guard.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_erebor_3_desc}You joined the Iron Guard, Erebor's shock troops, learning to hurl throwing axes and fight in the tight corridors of the mountain halls.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_erebor_4_text}Scouted the foothills of the Lonely Mountain.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_erebor_4_desc}You ventured into the wild lands around Erebor, tracking Orcs and wolves and safeguarding the mountain's approaches.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_erebor_5_text}Stood in the vanguard.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_erebor_5_desc}You trained as part of Erebor's vanguard, mastering the two-handed axe and polearm in the disciplined dwarven battle formations.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_erebor_6_text}Worked with the caravan guards.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_erebor_6_desc}You accompanied trading caravans between Erebor and Dale, learning the ways of commerce and the art of defending valuable cargo.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_rivendell_1_text}Trained with the Guard of Imladris.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_rivendell_1_desc}You served under the banners of Rivendell, training in mounted combat and the graceful Elven martial arts to defend the Last Homely House.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_rivendell_2_text}Stood watch at the halls of Elrond.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_rivendell_2_desc}You served as a sentry at the halls of Elrond, learning to read the land and anticipate threats before they could reach the hidden valley.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_rivendell_3_text}Ranged the Trollshaws with the border wardens.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_rivendell_3_desc}You joined the wardens who patrolled far beyond Rivendell's borders into the wild Trollshaws and the upper Anduin vales, learning to track enemies and read the signs of dark movement through ancient forest.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_rivendell_4_text}Trained in the art of Elven infantry.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_rivendell_4_desc}You stood with the ranks of Rivendell's warriors, mastering the spear and sword in the precise, deadly style of the High Elves.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_rivendell_5_text}Journeyed with the loremasters.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_rivendell_5_desc}You accompanied Rivendell's loremasters on their journeys, learning diplomacy, persuasion, and the art of leadership among the free peoples.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mirkwood_1_text}Trained with the Woodland Riders.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mirkwood_1_desc}You rode through the dark woods on swift Elven steeds, learning to fight from horseback among the ancient trees of Thranduil's realm.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mirkwood_2_text}Patrolled the darkened glades.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mirkwood_2_desc}You joined the wardens who patrolled the glades of Mirkwood, keeping watch against spiders, Orcs, and the creeping shadow of Dol Guldur.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mirkwood_3_text}Stood with the Elven Spear Guard.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mirkwood_3_desc}You took your place among the Spear Guard of the Woodland Realm, learning to fight in disciplined formations beneath the forest canopy.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mirkwood_4_text}Set traps for the spiders of Mirkwood.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mirkwood_4_desc}You were among the hunters tasked with keeping the great spiders from the Woodland Realm's heart, learning to lay snares and ambushes in the dark undergrowth and to strike with knife and hurled blade before the creatures could close with you.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mirkwood_5_text}Served in the halls of the Woodland King.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mirkwood_5_desc}You were admitted to the court of Thranduil, learning the diplomatic arts and the songs of the Woodland Elves under the tutelage of those who had sung since the first age of stars. The Elvenking's hall demanded as much from the tongue as from the sword-arm.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_lothlorien_1_text}Trained with the Galadhrim cavalry.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_lothlorien_1_desc}You joined the elite cavalry of Lothlorien, riding swift horses through the Golden Wood and learning to fight with the grace of the Galadhrim.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_lothlorien_2_text}Kept vigil on the flets of the Golden Wood.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_lothlorien_2_desc}You stood the long, still watches on the high platforms among the mallorn branches, your silver bow drawn across the threshold of the veiled borders. Nothing passed the Galadhrim wardens unseen — and you intended to keep it that way.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_lothlorien_3_text}Joined the archers of Caras Galadhon.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_lothlorien_3_desc}You trained with the famed archers of Lothlorien, learning to send arrows with deadly precision from the platforms among the mallorn trees.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_lothlorien_4_text}Joined the wardens of the trees.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_lothlorien_4_desc}You became a warden of the trees, defending the heart of Lothlorien with spear and sword in the ancient Elven tradition.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_lothlorien_5_text}Walked the mirror paths as a student of the Lady.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_lothlorien_5_desc}You studied the deeper arts of the Golden Wood under those closest to Galadriel's counsel, learning the songs of power and the quiet persuasion that could shift the will of lords without raising a blade. You left with gifts not easily named.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_isengard_1_text}Joined Saruman's Warg Riders.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_isengard_1_desc}You trained as a rider for Saruman's forces, learning to control Wargs and strike with devastating speed across the plains.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_isengard_2_text}Guarded the pits of Orthanc.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_isengard_2_desc}You were stationed at Orthanc, manning the crossbows and defending the breeding pits from any who would oppose Saruman's will.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_isengard_3_text}Fought among the Uruk-hai infantry.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_isengard_3_desc}You trained with the ferocious Uruk-hai, learning their brutal close-quarters fighting style and building endurance through grueling drills.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_isengard_4_text}Scouted for Saruman's spies.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_isengard_4_desc}You were sent as a scout and spy, ranging across the lands to gather intelligence for Saruman's war machine.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_isengard_5_text}Joined the ranks of Isengard's pikes.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_isengard_5_desc}You became a member of Isengard's formidable pikemen, learning to fight in tight formations that could break any cavalry charge.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_isengard_6_text}Fought your way through Saruman's warbands.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_isengard_6_desc}You proved yourself in the brutal warbands of Isengard, picking up every weapon style that kept you alive and leaving behind anything that did not. Saruman cared only for results and the warbands enforced that philosophy without mercy.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gundabad_1_text}Rode with the Warg riders of Gundabad.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gundabad_1_desc}You trained with the Warg riders of Mount Gundabad, learning to control the savage beasts through the treacherous mountain passes and to strike with lance and spear from their backs.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gundabad_2_text}Guarded the forges of Gundabad.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gundabad_2_desc}You served in the garrison of Gundabad, defending the forges and tunnels from intruders with bow and spear.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gundabad_3_text}Trained with the berserkers.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gundabad_3_desc}You were among the berserkers of Gundabad, learning to fight with reckless fury and overwhelming force.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gundabad_4_text}Scouted the mountain passes.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gundabad_4_desc}You roamed the treacherous mountain paths around Gundabad, tracking enemies and ensuring safe passage for your kin.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gundabad_5_text}Held the line in Gundabad's spear legions.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gundabad_5_desc}You drilled and marched with the heavy spear formations of Mount Gundabad, learning to brace against a charge and hold position under brutal northern conditions until the line could be relieved.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gundabad_6_text}Ran with the scavenger bands of the passes.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gundabad_6_desc}You lived outside the structure of the mountain clans, moving with the quick-fingered opportunists who followed warbands and picked over the aftermath of every skirmish. Throwing weapons and a fast pair of legs kept you alive when nothing else would.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_1_text}Served the Necromancer's riders.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_1_desc}You rode in the service of Dol Guldur, commanding dark steeds and spreading terror across the southern reaches of Mirkwood.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_2_text}Guarded the halls of shadow.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_2_desc}You defended the dark halls of Dol Guldur, standing watch over the Necromancer's domain with bow and blade.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_3_text}Trained in the dark arts of war.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_3_desc}You honed your skills in the dark arts of warfare, learning to fight with cunning and deception in the shadowed corridors of Dol Guldur.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_4_text}Hunted trespassers in the corrupted Greenwood.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_4_desc}You were sent into the twisted undergrowth of southern Mirkwood to track and eliminate those who strayed near the Necromancer's domain, learning to stalk quarry through corrupted forest without making a sound or leaving a print.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_5_text}Marched in the shadow legions of Dol Guldur.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_5_desc}You drilled in the iron-disciplined ranks of Dol Guldur's dark legions, learning to wield heavy weapons in formation as the corruption of the Necromancer's fortress settled into your stride and your silence.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_6_text}Moved through darkness as a courier of the Necromancer.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_6_desc}You carried messages through the corrupted wood that no one would write down, delivering them by hand to agents who never showed their faces. The work demanded silence, patience, and the ability to strike without warning when the shadow required it.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_1_text}Served in the Corsair Fleet.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_1_desc}You joined the Corsair Fleet of Umbar, learning to fight aboard ships and lead boarding parties against Gondor's coastal defenses.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_2_text}Guarded the harbors of Umbar.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_2_desc}You served in the harbor garrisons of Umbar, defending the docks and learning the art of coastal defense.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_3_text}Raided the shores of Gondor with the Corsairs.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_3_desc}You led the charge onto enemy docks, hurling javelins and cutting your way through defenders before retreating to the Black ships with what you had taken. Raids were fast and brutal, and you learned that hesitation cost lives.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_4_text}Navigated the Bay of Belfalas as a Corsair scout.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_4_desc}You served in the masthead and scout-boats of the Corsair fleet, reading tides and spotting prey across open water while learning to loose a bow from a pitching deck. What you saw decided whether a raid went ahead or was abandoned.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_5_text}Stood in the spear line of the Black Numenoreans.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_5_desc}You drilled in the disciplined ground formations of Umbar's infantry, learning to hold a coastal beachhead with spear and shield while the ships unloaded behind you. The Black Numenorean officers expected precision, and they got it.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_6_text}Ran with the outlaws of the Umbar waterfront.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_6_desc}You survived on the rough margins of the harbor city, moving goods that could not be declared and acquiring skills that could not be taught in any school. The Corsair world had a place for those clever enough to see opportunities no one else had noticed.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_empire_1_text}Rode with the Hill Riders.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_empire_1_desc}Mounted on sturdy hill ponies, you rode with the Hill Riders of Dunland, learning to fight across the rough terrain of the highlands.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_empire_2_text}Served in the Tribal Longhouse.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_empire_2_desc}Within the tribal longhouses of Dunland, you learned tactics and the art of command, planning raids and defenses for your clan.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_empire_3_text}Stood guard with the Border Watch.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_empire_3_desc}You joined the Border Watch of Dunland, hurling javelins and fighting with sword to defend your clan's territory.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_empire_4_text}Scouted the highlands.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_empire_4_desc}You roamed the highlands and forests as a scout, learning to read the land and shoot from horseback.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_empire_5_text}Joined the Spear Brothers.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_empire_5_desc}You became one of the Spear Brothers of Dunland, learning to fight in tight formations with spear and shield.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_empire_6_text}Harried the horse-lords as a Tribal Skirmisher.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_empire_6_desc}As a Tribal Skirmisher, you learned to ambush Rohirrim outriders in the passes, hurling javelins and vanishing into the ridgeline before they could counter. The old grudge against the horse-lords lived in every throw.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_1_text}Trained with the Riders of the Mark.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_1_desc}You proved your skill as a rider among the Rohirrim, learning to charge with lance and fight from horseback in the traditions of Eorl the Young.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_2_text}Served in the city watch of Edoras.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_2_desc}You stood guard over the gates and walls of Edoras, learning tactics and discipline in service of the Golden Hall.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_3_text}Joined the skirmishers of the Westfold.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_3_desc}You joined the Westfold skirmishers, learning to fight with thrown weapons and sword on the open plains.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_4_text}Rode with the scouts of the Wold.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_4_desc}You rode with the scouts of the Wold, ranging far across the plains to watch for threats from the East.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_5_text}Stood among the spearmen of the Eastfold.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_5_desc}As a spearman of the Eastfold, you learned to hold the shieldwall against the enemy's charge.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_6_text}Traveled with the camp followers of Rohan.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_6_desc}Rather than taking up arms directly, you traveled with the camp followers, learning to survive on the march and profit from the chaos of war.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_sturgia_1_text}Served in the Royal Guard of Dale.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_sturgia_1_desc}You pledged your loyalty to the King of Dale, serving in the Royal Guard and learning the martial traditions of the Men of the North.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_sturgia_2_text}Defended the gates of Dale.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_sturgia_2_desc}As a member of the garrison, you defended the rebuilt gates of Dale, learning the art of siege defense from veterans who had seen the city fall and rise again.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_sturgia_3_text}Fought in the militia of the Long Lake shore.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_sturgia_3_desc}You trained with the lake-shore militia, learning to fight with thrown weapons and sword in defense of the settlements that straddled the trade route between Dale and the south. Commerce and combat were equally part of daily life.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_sturgia_4_text}Tracked game and Orcs in the forest east of Dale.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_sturgia_4_desc}You ranged the dark woodlands east of the Long Lake, hunting game for the market and keeping a watchful eye on the Orc paths coming down from the mountains. The forest taught you to read the land and keep your bow strung at all times.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_sturgia_5_text}Joined the shieldwall.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_sturgia_5_desc}You took your place in Dale's shieldwall, learning to stand firm with spear and shield against any enemy that threatened the city.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_sturgia_6_text}Traveled with the merchant caravans of the North.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_sturgia_6_desc}You went with the caravans that moved between Dale, Erebor, and the southern kingdoms, learning the arts of commerce, survival on the road, and the opportunism that made some traders very successful and others very sorry.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_aserai_1_text}Trained with the war elephants.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_aserai_1_desc}You trained alongside Harad's mighty war elephants, learning to ride and fight from their towering backs under the blazing southern sun.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_aserai_2_text}Watched the walls of Harad's desert cities.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_aserai_2_desc}You served as a sentinel on the sun-baked battlements of Harad's fortified cities, learning to scan the shimmering horizon for enemy movement and to direct arrow fire against raiders from the desert fringe.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_aserai_3_text}Rode with the desert outriders.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_aserai_3_desc}You joined Harad's swift outriders, scouting the vast desert on horseback and striking at the enemy's flanks before vanishing back into the heat-haze.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_aserai_4_text}Drilled with the Black Serpent's footmen.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_aserai_4_desc}You trained in the disciplined spear formations that served under the Black Serpent banner, learning to hold position in the merciless desert heat and advance in step with warriors sworn to carry the war into the north.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_aserai_5_text}Harassed enemies as a javelin skirmisher of Harad.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_aserai_5_desc}You fought in the loose Haradrim skirmishing style, hurling javelins to soften the enemy before closing with sword and buckler. The heat and the sand were on your side, and you learned to use both.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_aserai_6_text}Wandered with the nomadic tribes of the Sunlands.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_aserai_6_desc}You drifted with the wandering people of the deep desert, learning to read water-signs and navigate the dune-sea by starlight. When coin ran short you found other ways to survive, and the vast empty Sunlands gave you room to perfect them.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_battania_1_text}Rode with the Rangers of the North.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_battania_1_desc}You were taken into the company of the Dunedain Rangers, learning to ride hard through the ruins of Arnor and fight with the disciplined ferocity of the Heirs of Isildur. The Rangers rode far and told little to any they met on the road.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_battania_2_text}Watched the crossroads of Eriador.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_battania_2_desc}You kept vigil over the crumbling watchtowers and old road-crossings of the North Kingdom, learning to read the land and spot the signs of Orc movement before trouble arrived. The Rangers held no formal posts, only duty.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_battania_3_text}Ranged the wilds of Arnor as a Dunedain scout.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_battania_3_desc}You moved through the old kingdom's overgrown ruins and moorlands as a ranger scout, learning to live off the wild land and track both beast and enemy across terrain that held memory in its stones. Speed and silence were your only tools.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_battania_4_text}Stood in the Ranger line against the Orc warbands.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_battania_4_desc}You fought in the close-quarters engagements that kept the northern settlements alive, learning to wield sword and spear with the steadiness of men who knew they were the last line between the people and the dark. There were no reinforcements in the North.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_battania_5_text}Moved unseen among the villages of the North.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_battania_5_desc}You kept the hidden network of Dunedain informants alive, passing between settlements under assumed names and gathering word of Orc movements, dark strangers, and threats to the people. The Rangers relied on those who could pass for ordinary, and you had the gift.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_battania_6_text}Tracked and ambushed in the ruins of the North Kingdom.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_battania_6_desc}You learned to set ambushes in the old ruins and thickets of ruined Arnor, reading trails and using the broken landscape to your advantage. A well-placed arrow from cover was worth a dozen men in the open, and you made every shot count.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_khuzait_1_text}Rode with the Khelek Warriors.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_khuzait_1_desc}You proved your worth as a rider among the Khelek Warriors, learning mounted combat on the wide steppes of Rhun in the tradition of the eastern war-riders.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_khuzait_2_text}Guarded the settlements of Rhun.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_khuzait_2_desc}You patrolled the walls of Rhun's settlements, learning archery and the art of defense against raiders from the wild eastern steppes.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_khuzait_3_text}Joined the ranks of the Uruk-thar.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_khuzait_3_desc}As a member of the Uruk-thar, you learned to fight with thrown weapons and sword in the Easterling skirmishing tradition.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_khuzait_4_text}Ranged the Sea of Rhun shores as a mounted scout.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_khuzait_4_desc}You rode far ahead of the eastern columns along the shores of the inland sea, reading the land for threats and opportunity. The steppe gave you a horseman's eye for distance and a bowman's patience for the right moment.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_khuzait_5_text}Held the line in the Easterling spear formation.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_khuzait_5_desc}You stood shoulder to shoulder with your kinsmen in the disciplined Easterling spear line, learning to brace against cavalry and advance in ordered ranks under the red dawn banners that had marched west before.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_khuzait_6_text}Traveled with the Karash bands.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_khuzait_6_desc}You lived outside formal Easterling clan structure, moving with the Karash bands who followed the armies and profited from their passage. Cunning and thrown weapons kept you fed on the margins of the great eastern host.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_goblin_1_text}Rode with the warg-packs of the High Pass.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_goblin_1_desc}You trained with the Warg riders of the High Pass, learning to control the savage beasts through the treacherous mountain passes and to strike with lance and spear from their backs.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_goblin_2_text}Guarded the warrens of Goblin-town.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_goblin_2_desc}You served in the warrens of Goblin-town, defending the forges and tunnels from intruders with bow and spear.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_goblin_3_text}Trained with the berserkers.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_goblin_3_desc}You were among the berserkers of Goblin-town, learning to fight with reckless fury and overwhelming force.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_goblin_4_text}Scouted the mountain passes.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_goblin_4_desc}You roamed the treacherous mountain paths around Goblin-town, tracking enemies and ensuring safe passage for your kin.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_goblin_5_text}Held the line in Goblin-town's spear legions.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_goblin_5_desc}You drilled and marched with the heavy spear formations of the High Pass, learning to brace against a charge and hold position under brutal northern conditions until the line could be relieved.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_goblin_6_text}Ran with the scavenger bands of the passes.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_goblin_6_desc}You lived outside the structure of the mountain clans, moving with the quick-fingered opportunists who followed warbands and picked over the aftermath of every skirmish. Throwing weapons and a fast pair of legs kept you alive when nothing else would.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mistymountainorcs_1_text}Rode with the warg-riders of the Misty Mountains.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mistymountainorcs_1_desc}You trained with the Warg riders of the Misty Mountains, learning to control the savage beasts through the treacherous mountain passes and to strike with lance and spear from their backs.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mistymountainorcs_2_text}Guarded the deep forges of Moria.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mistymountainorcs_2_desc}You served in the garrison of Moria, defending the forges and tunnels from intruders with bow and spear.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mistymountainorcs_3_text}Trained with the berserkers.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mistymountainorcs_3_desc}You were among the berserkers of the Misty Mountains, learning to fight with reckless fury and overwhelming force.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mistymountainorcs_4_text}Scouted the mountain passes.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mistymountainorcs_4_desc}You roamed the treacherous mountain paths around the Misty Mountains, tracking enemies and ensuring safe passage for your kin.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mistymountainorcs_5_text}Held the line in the Misty Mountains's spear legions.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mistymountainorcs_5_desc}You drilled and marched with the heavy spear formations of the Misty Mountains, learning to brace against a charge and hold position under brutal northern conditions until the line could be relieved.
{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mistymountainorcs_6_text}Ran with the scavenger bands of the passes.

{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mistymountainorcs_6_desc}You lived outside the structure of the mountain clans, moving with the quick-fingered opportunists who followed warbands and picked over the aftermath of every skirmish. Throwing weapons and a fast pair of legs kept you alive when nothing else would.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_1_text}Drilled with the sons of noble houses.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_1_desc}You grew up training alongside the children of Gondor's noble families in the yards of Minas Tirith. You learned to fight with sword and lance under knights sworn to the Steward, and spent long hours practicing horsemanship on the Pelennor.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_2_text}Apprenticed in the markets of Minas Tirith.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_2_desc}You spent your adolescence running errands and learning accounts in the tiered market halls of the White City. You quickly learned the art of the deal, flattering merchants and counting coin in the shadow of the White Tower.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_3_text}Labored in the fields of the Pelennor.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_3_desc}You toiled from dawn to dusk in the rich farmland outside the city walls, hauling sheaves and driving oxen across the Pelennor. When the levy was called you were handed a spear and drilled in formation by a gruff veteran of the border wars.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_4_text}Apprenticed to an armourer of the White City.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_4_desc}You learned your craft in the smithing quarter of Minas Tirith, blowing bellows and grinding edges under a master armorer's stern eye. By the time you were grown your hands were calloused from hammer work and you could judge a blade's temper by its ring.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_5_text}Ranged the wilds of Ithilien.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_5_desc}You shadowed the Rangers of Ithilien as a youngster, learning to move without sound through the overgrown gardens east of the Anduin. You strung your first bow before you were tall enough to draw it properly and learned to read boot-prints in the mud.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_6_text}Scrounged among the ruins of Osgiliath.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_6_desc}You grew up picking through the shattered stones of Osgiliath, selling salvage to soldiers and running messages between outposts for coin. The ruined city taught you quickness and cunning — a thrown rock could drive off a man twice your size.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_1_text}Fought in the training pits of Barad-dur.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_1_desc}You were thrown into the pit-fighting yards of the Dark Tower as soon as you could hold a weapon. The older warriors showed no mercy, and you learned quickly that hesitation meant pain. Pain taught you to strike first and strike hard.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_2_text}Hauled supply trains along the Black Road.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_2_desc}You moved goods along the shadowed roads of Mordor, learning to barter and bluff your way past toll-keepers and corrupt overseers. The danger sharpened your wits, and you discovered that information was worth more than iron in the Dark Land.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_3_text}Labored in the forges of the Dark Land.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_3_desc}You hauled stone and worked bellows in the smoking forges that ringed Barad-dur, enduring heat and ash from before first light until long after dark. The work broke weaker youths, but you found a grim endurance that no taskmaster could extinguish.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_4_text}Kept order among the Orc work gangs.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_4_desc}You were given a club and a corner of the yard and told to keep the work gangs in line. You learned fast how to read a crowd and where to hit to get compliance without killing. Strategy and brutality became second nature.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_5_text}Hunted across the plains of Gorgoroth.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_5_desc}You tracked prey across the blasted volcanic flats of Gorgoroth, learning to read ash-trails and navigate by the glow of distant fires. There was little to hunt, and what little there was fought back. You came home lean and sharp-eyed.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_6_text}Ran with the outcasts beyond the Black Gate.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_6_desc}You survived on the margins of the Dark Lord's realm, running with the quick-fingered bands who slipped past patrols and lived by theft and misdirection. You learned every shadow and every bribe-price in the shadow of the Morannon.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_erebor_1_text}Trained in the great hall with the King's axe-brothers.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_erebor_1_desc}You practiced combat alongside the young warriors of Dain's household, learning to swing the two-handed axe in the echoing training halls deep beneath the Lonely Mountain. Every scar was a lesson; every lesson was a point of pride.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_erebor_2_text}Apprenticed at the forges of Erebor.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_erebor_2_desc}You spent your youth at the smith's bench, learning to work metal in the blazing heart of the Lonely Mountain. You mastered the values of craft and trade, carrying finished blades to the markets of Dale when the light faded on the forge.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_erebor_3_text}Worked the deep mines of the Lonely Mountain.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_erebor_3_desc}You swung a pick in the lowest galleries of Erebor before you were old enough to shave, learning the mountain's hidden passages and the engineering of tunnels and supports. The deep stone became as familiar to you as open sky.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_erebor_4_text}Drilled with the Ironfoot shieldwall.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_erebor_4_desc}You trained in the disciplined close-quarters style of Dain Ironfoot's warriors, learning to brace a shield and swing an axe in tight tunnel formations. Your short stride was an advantage in the corridors where taller folk stumbled.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_erebor_5_text}Counted coin in the treasury vaults.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_erebor_5_desc}You assisted in tallying Erebor's vast wealth from an early age, learning to manage ledgers and understand the logistics of supplying a mountain kingdom. The work made you methodical and gave you a strategist's eye for resources.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_erebor_6_text}Patrolled the foothills and forest trails.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_erebor_6_desc}You ranged the slopes around Erebor as part of the outer watch, learning to track Orc raiding parties and shoot from concealment in the pine forest. The mountain air sharpened your senses and distance became your ally.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_rivendell_1_text}Trained in the riding courts of Imladris.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_rivendell_1_desc}You practiced the mounted arts in the quiet training grounds of Rivendell, learning to ride and fight with the fluid grace that Elven tradition demanded. The great library was never far, and your education in blade and lore went hand in hand.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_rivendell_2_text}Studied craft and lore in Elrond's halls.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_rivendell_2_desc}You spent your formative years learning the craft-arts and histories preserved in Rivendell, working alongside master artisans and loremasters. Long evenings of talk sharpened your tongue and your understanding of the world's deep past.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_rivendell_3_text}Tended the gardens and orchards of the Hidden Valley.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_rivendell_3_desc}You worked the terraced gardens of Imladris, learning patience and diligence from Elves who had tended those same beds for an age. Between rows you practiced swordplay, finding that tending living things gave you an instinct for measured force.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_rivendell_4_text}Walked the border watches of Imladris.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_rivendell_4_desc}You accompanied the Elven wardens on their long circuits around the valley's hidden paths, learning to read the forest and loose an arrow before your quarry heard you coming. The valley's peace was hard-won and you helped keep it.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_rivendell_5_text}Learned healing arts in the halls of Elrond.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_rivendell_5_desc}You served in the healing rooms of Rivendell, learning herb-lore and the arts of mending under the guidance of Elrond's healers. Tending to weary travellers and wounded Elves gave you both knowledge and the empathy that comes with it.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_rivendell_6_text}Wandered the wild roads beyond the valley.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_rivendell_6_desc}You slipped beyond Rivendell's borders as often as you could, exploring the Trollshaws and the valleys of the Misty Mountains. You developed a taste for risk and discovered that you could survive on cunning where a sword would only bring trouble.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_mirkwood_1_text}Drilled with the household guard of Thranduil's court.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_mirkwood_1_desc}You trained with the young warriors of the Woodland King's household, learning to move and fight among the great beeches beneath the mountain halls. The court was demanding, and you were expected to be as sharp with words as with your blade.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_mirkwood_2_text}Carried goods along the Forest Road.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_mirkwood_2_desc}You escorted trade goods through the shadows of Mirkwood, learning to read the forest and haggle at the far end of a dangerous journey. The path was never safe, and the merchants who survived were charming, quick, and watchful.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_mirkwood_3_text}Gathered and farmed on the forest margins.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_mirkwood_3_desc}You grew up tending the clearings and cultivated patches at the edges of the Woodland Realm, harvesting what the shadowed forest would yield. It was hard and dangerous work, and you learned to move fast when the dark things came near.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_mirkwood_4_text}Crafted bows and woodwork in the Elvenking's halls.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_mirkwood_4_desc}You learned your craft from the Elven bowyers of Mirkwood, shaping staves and stringing the famous Woodland bows. The work required equal measures of patience and precision, and you left with hands that could shape a weapon as readily as use one.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_mirkwood_5_text}Hunted deep in the shadowed wood.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_mirkwood_5_desc}You followed the Woodland hunters into the darkest parts of Mirkwood, tracking deer and boar through the corrupted undergrowth. Every hunt risked an encounter with the forest's creatures, and you learned to shoot before you heard a sound clearly.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_mirkwood_6_text}Ran with the forest border watch.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_mirkwood_6_desc}You kept irregular company with the patrols that roamed outside Thranduil's formal borders, learning to set traps and ambushes for the spider-kin and Orc scouts that tested the Woodland Realm's edges. Cunning kept you alive where courage alone would not.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_lothlorien_1_text}Trained with the wardens of Caras Galadhon.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_lothlorien_1_desc}You practiced the warrior arts in the silver courts of Caras Galadhon, learning the sweeping sword-style of the Galadhrim under the light of the Lady's power. Every morning began with drills and every evening with starlight and long memory.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_lothlorien_2_text}Wove and crafted in the mallorn-city.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_lothlorien_2_desc}You learned the textile and craft arts of Lothlórien, working with the famous Elven weavers who produced cloth of silver and gold. The work required uncommon precision, and you found that beauty and persuasion were inseparable in the Golden Wood.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_lothlorien_3_text}Kept watch from the flets of the mallorn trees.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_lothlorien_3_desc}You stood the long quiet vigils on the high platforms among the mallorn branches, learning to read the forest below and loose silver-tipped arrows with deadly calm. The endless patience of those watches shaped your eye and stilled your hand.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_lothlorien_4_text}Patrolled the silver borders of the Golden Wood.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_lothlorien_4_desc}You walked the outer marches of Lothlórien, learning to spot the signs of Orc incursion at the Dimrill Dale passes. Long days of silent observation followed by sudden action shaped you into a hunter as patient as the wood and as quick as the arrow.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_lothlorien_5_text}Studied the healing arts of the Golden Wood.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_lothlorien_5_desc}You apprenticed among the healers of Lothlórien, gathering athelas and learning the lore of herb and wound under the instruction of those who had practiced the art for centuries. The Lady's grace touched all healing within those borders.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_lothlorien_6_text}Wandered beyond the wood on private errands.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_lothlorien_6_desc}You often slipped beyond the veiled borders of Lothlórien alone, exploring the Anduin's banks and the brown lands beyond out of restless curiosity. You learned to pass unseen and to use misdirection when straightforward paths were barred to you.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_1_text}Trained in the war-yard of Orthanc.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_1_desc}You were run through brutal drills in the packed-earth yards of Isengard, learning to wield halberd and two-hander under the eyes of Uruk-hai sergeants. Saruman's forces trained without mercy, and softness was driven out of you fast.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_2_text}Apprenticed in the machine-shops beneath Orthanc.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_2_desc}You learned to work metal and manage materials in the smoky workshops that fed Saruman's war machine, picking up the arts of crafting and supply under pressure. The work was constant and inventive, and Saruman rewarded ingenuity.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_3_text}Dug and hauled in the pits of Isengard.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_3_desc}You were put to work in the pits as soon as you were strong enough, breaking rock and hauling spoil to feed Saruman's endless construction. The work built your endurance past what most men's bodies could bear.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_4_text}Trained alongside the Uruk-hai infantry.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_4_desc}You ran drills alongside the bred warriors of Isengard, learning to brace and hold with spear and to cut with sword in tight formation. Being neither Uruk nor pure Man you had to be twice as relentless to be accepted.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_5_text}Scouted the plains of Rohan for Saruman's eyes.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_5_desc}You ranged the Wold and the approaches to Helm's Deep as a scout for Isengard, learning to travel fast and unseen across open country. Reading the land and avoiding the Rohirrim patrols sharpened your instincts to a fine edge.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_6_text}Ran information through Isengard's shadows.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_6_desc}You were quick-fingered and clever enough to be used as a courier and informant in the grey world of Saruman's spy networks. You learned how much a secret was worth and how much pain it cost to keep one.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_gundabad_1_text}Trained in the war-halls of Mount Gundabad.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_gundabad_1_desc}You were blooded in the torch-lit training halls of the mountain stronghold, learning to ride hard and swing heavy weapons in the tradition of the northern Orc clans. Status came to those who could prove themselves in the pit before their elders.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_gundabad_2_text}Apprenticed in the weapon-smiths of Gundabad.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_gundabad_2_desc}You learned to forge crude but effective arms in the noisy smithing halls of the mountain, learning to trade them for supplies and favors. The work was ugly but the skills were real, and you left the forge knowing both iron and dealing.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_gundabad_3_text}Dug in the mines beneath the mountain.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_gundabad_3_desc}You swung a pick in the lightless shafts of Gundabad, learning the mountain's structure and the engineering of the pit supports. The tunnels were your home and you could navigate them blind, which was often how you had to.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_gundabad_4_text}Fought in the passes of the Grey Mountains.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_gundabad_4_desc}You ran with the raiding bands that struck into the Grey Mountains, learning to fight with axe and spear in the brutal hit-and-run style of the northern clans. You came back meaner each time and a little more certain of your own survival.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_gundabad_5_text}Ranged the wild lands around Gundabad.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_gundabad_5_desc}You patrolled the rocky wilderness surrounding the mountain fortress, tracking intruders and reading signs of enemy movement. The cold northern wilds gave you patience and a bowman's stillness that outlasted any target.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_gundabad_6_text}Survived alone in the mountain passes.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_gundabad_6_desc}Cast out or escaping some debt, you fended for yourself in the treacherous passes around the mountain, surviving by theft and quick thinking. The experience left you with no illusions about loyalty and a sharp talent for getting out of trouble.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_1_text}Drilled in the shadow-yards of Dol Guldur.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_1_desc}You trained in the lightless courtyards of the Necromancer's fortress, learning to fight with halberd and great blade under the eye of hooded overseers. The shadow that lay across the place seeped into your bones and sharpened your instincts for violence.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_2_text}Forged shadow-steel in the dark workshops.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_2_desc}You worked the black-iron forges of Dol Guldur, learning to shape weapons under conditions that would break a lesser youth. The materials were dark and the methods darker, and you left with knowledge that few would admit to having.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_3_text}Hauled stone in the caverns of the fortress.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_3_desc}You labored in the underground excavations of Dol Guldur, dragging blocks and shoring tunnels in the permanent darkness beneath the corrupted hill. The work was relentless, and endurance was the only currency that bought any relief.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_4_text}Fought in the shadow-patrols of the Enchanted Wood.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_4_desc}You ran with the dark patrols that pushed the corruption of Dol Guldur further into southern Mirkwood, cutting down resistance with axe and spear. Each foray took you deeper into the twisted forest and left less of your former self behind.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_5_text}Hunted the dark forest's edges.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_5_desc}You tracked through the corrupted undergrowth of southern Mirkwood, killing any creature that came too close to the fortress and learning to move without making a sound in a forest that twisted every trail. Your eyes adjusted to a world without sunlight.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_6_text}Moved through shadows as a spy of the Necromancer.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_6_desc}You were used as a courier and agent in the Necromancer's network, carrying messages through the dark wood and delivering them to contacts who never showed their faces. You learned that shadows were your armor and silence your best weapon.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_1_text}Learned seamanship and swordsmanship aboard the Black ships.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_1_desc}You were taken to sea young, learning to hand a sail and fight with the cutlass and boarding axe of the Corsair tradition. The deck of a warship was your training ground, and the Anduin Delta was your proving ground.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_2_text}Ran the quays and counting-houses of the harbor.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_2_desc}You grew up quick-tongued and quick-fingered in the busy dockyards of Umbar, learning to charm buyers, spot inflated bills, and move goods past customs without asking awkward questions. The harbor was a school in commerce and deception alike.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_3_text}Worked the shipyards of Umbar.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_3_desc}You learned to shape timber and caulk planking in the great ship-sheds of Umbar, studying the engineering of vessels that carried war across the sea. When you were not building ships you were thinking about how they might be broken.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_4_text}Raided Gondor's coastal villages with the Corsairs.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_4_desc}You made your first raids on the coasts of Gondor as little more than a youth, fighting at the front of a boarding party with sword and throwing knife. The raids were brutal and swift, and they taught you exactly what violence was worth.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_5_text}Navigated the Corsair lanes from the crow's nest.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_5_desc}You served as lookout and scout-sailor, learning to read the sea and chart a course through the dangerous waters of the Bay of Belfalas. What you spotted from the masthead determined whether a raid succeeded or became a catastrophe.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_6_text}Moved contraband through Umbar's back alleys.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_6_desc}You ran in the shadow economy of the harbor city, carrying goods that could not be declared and messages that could not be written down. The work paid in secrets and small coins, and you learned every fence, bribe, and bolt-hole in Umbar.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_empire_1_text}Trained with the young warriors of the clan chief.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_empire_1_desc}You drilled with the chieftain's sons in the muddy practice-grounds of the hill stronghold, learning to ride hard and swing a two-hander in the rough Dunlending style. Every bruise was a lesson and every lesson carried the old grudge against the horse-lords.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_empire_2_text}Traded between the hill clans and the lowland markets.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_empire_2_desc}You carried goods and news between the hill settlements and the river markets, learning to bargain hard and smile at buyers you did not trust. The roads between Dunland and the wider world were rough, and charm was often cheaper than a sword.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_empire_3_text}Herded sheep and sharpened spears on the Dunland hills.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_empire_3_desc}You spent your youth minding the flocks across the wind-scoured hillsides of Dunland, and when the call came you were handed a spear and shoved into the levy. The hills made you tough and the levy made you dangerous.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_empire_4_text}Worked the forge and the woodcarving bench.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_empire_4_desc}You learned to shape metal and wood in the practical crafts of the Dunlending settlements, making tools, weapons, and fittings for the clans. The work gave you clever hands and an eye for how things were put together and how they could be taken apart.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_empire_5_text}Hunted and foraged in the forests of Dunland.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_empire_5_desc}You learned the wooded ridges bordering the Misty Mountains as a young hunter, tracking deer and picking up the bow before most children could properly grip it. The forest kept its secrets, and you learned most of them.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_empire_6_text}Drifted between the clans as an outcast.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_empire_6_desc}You were cast out or wandered off, spending your formative years on the margins of Dunlending society, picking up work and trouble in equal measure. You learned that a well-aimed throw or a convincing lie could open doors that no clan-badge would.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_1_text}Rode in training with the Marshal's household.

{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_1_desc}You spent your youth learning the art of mounted war in service to one of the marshals of the Riddermark, drilling with lance and sword in the wide grasslands of Rohan. Horsemanship was not taught in the Riddermark — it was breathed.
{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_2_text}Traded goods through the Riddermark markets.
